events.title: Tornado near Valley Center
events.description: 1 death. Sedgwick County. A brief tornado developed and quickly intensified over one property. The brunt of the damage was to a double wide manufactured home that was bolted to a poured basement foundation. This home was lifted and completely taken apart with the frame bent and twisted. Unfortunately there was a fatality for this resident who was thrown in the field to the north of the property. Most of the debris from the home and two outbuildings was pushed to the northeast into an open field and could be found for six miles to the northeast. A neighboring house to the west had damage to the edge of the roof and…

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Wilson Lake
events.description: 1 death. Russell County. Multiple campers were blown over throughout the state park at Wilson Lake with debris spreading all over. Three people were transported to the hospital with injuries, and one person was found deceased.

events.title: Heavy Rain near (cnu)johnson Arpt Ch
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Neosho County. Heavy rain was occurring according to the nearby airport observation at Chanute Martin Johnson Airport when a car crossed the center line and hit a semi freightliner head-on. Unfortunately the driver of the car died from this car crash near the intersection of Kansas Highway 39 and Brown Road.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Rose Hill
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Butler County. Thunderstorm winds downed a tree over the road near SW 180th and SW Indianola Rd sometime prior to 5 am. I driver of a pick up apparently did not see the downed tree and drove into it, which proved fatal.

events.title: Lightning near Elk City Lake
events.description: 1 death. Montgomery County. A participant in the Flat Rock Ultra Trail race was struck by lightning less than one quarter of a mile away from the finish line.

events.title: Flood near Hutchinson
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Reno County. A gentleman was ejected from an ATV when he encountered a washed out section of road from heavy rains 5 to 6 days earlier. He landed in a puddle of water and the ATV then landed on top of him pinning him to the ground and under water causing him to drown.||The road in question did not have any flowing water at the time and was dry with a few residual puddles remaining. ||Rainfall from several days earlier caused minor field flooding in which water ran from one field across the road into another field. The flow of water eroded portions of the road.

events.title: Flash Flood near Elk City Lake
events.description: 2 deaths. Montgomery County. Torrential rains within a bowl shaped landscape produced catastrophic flooding of Racket Creek. Rainfall amounts up to 8.5 inches fell in an isolated area in which the creek ran between a pair of elevated regions causing significant and rapid rises of the creek. Water was estimated to be approximately 4 feet above road level and rushing rapidly. It was reported that the gentlemen were driving a pickup and may have encountered an obstacle in the rushing waters causing them to stop. The rushing waters overcame the vehicle and swept it off of the road and into the creek channel. It was estimated…

events.title: Flash Flood near New Lancaster
events.description: 1 death. Miami County. A vehicle hydroplaned off the road on HWY 69 near 363rd Street. The vehicle left the roadway, then sank into the flooded ditch alongside the road. An occupant in the vehicle perished.

events.title: Flash Flood near New Almelo
events.description: 1 death. Norton County. The North Fork of the Solomon River was out of its banks causing all of Lenora to be flooded, along with a stretch of Highway 9 coming into town as well as elsewhere in the southern part of the county. Swift water rescues occurred in the southern part of Norton county during the late evening of the third. One of these rescues involved a couple who under estimated the depth of the water over the highway and drove through the flood waters on Highway 9. The vehicle was washed off the road and caught in a tree. The couple escaped from the vehicle and climbed into the tree, remaining there until…

events.title: Flash Flood near Rose Hill
events.description: 1 death. Butler County. Water was flowing across many area roads. Several swift water rescues were performed. In a couple of cases, the vehicles were swept of off the roadway. Four individuals were in those vehicles and two were found and rescued. One other individual had been swept downstream and appeared to rescuers as he walked out of a soybean field. Unfortunately, one person was not found until later and had perished.

events.title: Flood near Colwich
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Sedgwick County. Multiple reports of 3 to 6 inches of water over the roads. The usual flood locations remained under water for a considerable amount of time.

events.title: Flash Flood near Plymouth
events.description: 1 death. Lyon County. Flooding over the Kansas turnpike at mile marker 118. This shut down the northbound lanes. A 21 year old male driver hydroplaned and lost control of his vehicle. The vehicle left the road and was then swept downstream by the flood waters. He was not able to survive.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Shallow Water
events.description: 1 death. Scott County. A severe thunderstorm passing to the north brought high wind on the south side. A 61 year old male was killed when his modular home was overturned and destroyed by the high wind.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Emporia
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Lyon County. From the Emporia Gazette newspaper: An Emporia man died this morning from injuries resulting from a tree falling on top of him.
